findings.issue: Locally editable JSON strings are treated as owner/reviewer/rights authorization without validating external attestation, issuer, signature or exact evidence reference. SHA equality of local inputs does not prove lawful access.
findings.remedy: Bind runner release to GitHub-pinned/independently authenticated reviewer and owner evidence plus AD-00/AD-01C/E6 attestation, deny mismatched/missing/replayed/spoofed permits in independent negative QA.

findings.issue: underlying_inventory_sha256 is checked only as 64 lowercase hex, not against frozen original tokenizer inventory or verified non-special/reserved taxonomy. A fabricated metadata JSON with any 64-hex value passes format checks.
findings.remedy: Verify source inventory bytes against pinned SHA and reserved/special identity through a separate authorized custody receipt; test forged, zero, swapped or mismatched metadata without inspecting private bytes before rights.

findings.issue: fixture-freeze writes only a hash/receipt, not the 80 immutable case records, per-case oracle/group SHA, or demonstrably externally frozen pre-I2 evidence. Run recomputes fixture and compares an editable permit field.
findings.remedy: Persist locked 80-case fixture and per-case/group manifest within approved private scope, independent 80/80 oracle and mutation QA, authenticated pre-I2 receipt, and make I2 verify those exact bytes with no silent regeneration/substitution.

findings.issue: Both default paths point to _tmp/ttm_sm4m_diag_q001_candidate instead of the GitHub-vetted tools/pilot_t4/direct_failure_diag_q001/preexec_candidate_20261116 directory; default path cannot select the reviewed runner reliably.
findings.remedy: Fix defaults to an exact GitHub checkout relative to script location, enforce full 64-hex runner SHA, verify PowerShell 5.1 on Windows Python 3.12 using source-only tests. Do not silently copy or rename ZIP files.

findings.issue: 18/18 mock and 21/21 author-created checker do not cover independently exercised wrong shift/full-sequence CE, eval gradient leak, forged owner permit/rights, broken P02/checkpoint pins, process/resource STOP, malformed output, or actual Windows integration.
findings.remedy: Provide one distinct pinned-source negative test suite and readback; test failures before any model execution; rights-dependent checks remain NOT_EXECUTED until authorized.

findings.issue: AD-00/AD-01C/E6 and private step1024 checkpoint current custody unverified; historical checkpoint SHA does not constitute authorized access. Host CPU/torch/psutil and exact runtime not independently verified.
findings.remedy: Owner/external rights attestation scoped to exact checkpoint/model and source, authorized private byte readback, frozen Python 3.12/torch/psutil environment and resource preflight before any I1 release/I2 run.

findings.issue: Finite gradients are checked but nonzero weight delta is not measured or asserted; the frozen primary endpoint requires finite gradient AND weight change. Receipt lacks measured weight-delta and peak RSS.
findings.remedy: Record pinned parameter pre/post SHA/norm and strictly positive finite delta, sampled/peak RSS, executable versions, and full step0/256 counts without changing optimizer or endpoints.

findings.issue: Python resource check is cooperative between operations, while 1GiB limit covers serialized receipt only, not total files/log streams. External 900s process-tree kill has no independent Windows negative QA.
findings.remedy: Independently test watchdog kill, peak RSS and aggregate log/output cap in Windows; account for crash/stall and no-retry one-shot semantics.

findings.issue: README says 17/17 but original receipt says 18/18 mock source QA.
findings.remedy: Fix README in a new remediation commit; retain original SHA-pinned candidate evidence.

findings.issue: Four-choice set places gold first and draws mainly from fixed low-sorted value tokens; it does not validate per-case distractor hardness or include bound-value distractors systematically. Restricted comparison must not be overinterpreted.
findings.remedy: Document exact candidate-choice semantics and limitations, or propose protocol amendment before I1 with distinct review, never posthoc after model outputs.

remediation_scope: Single integrated amendment at new commit, same QuestionID and frozen control parameters; remediate and obtain distinct source/negative QA plus rights before I1/I2
